confirmation_generation_rule: Only after checkpoints and all source files have been hashed and frozen. All four regimes reported; no retuning.
known_model_reference: ordinary two-accumulator Bayes filter plus the same closed-form risk; constructive equivalence control, not an extra observation
input_contract: All predictors see identical causal sensor increments, interval lengths, sensor standard deviations and query parameters; no hidden drift label at inference. Sufficient features are deterministic transforms, and their preparation is included in timing.
supervised_target: Exact conditional event probability in a declared known generative model; sampled event labels are reserved for calibration reporting. This is not model-free learning.

architecture.analytic_trainable: two positive sufficient-statistic scales and three prior logits

gates.memory_function: mean confirmation MSE below memoryless and lower expected protective-action regret
gates.irreducibility: fails if an ordinary recurrent/gated/direct head, including a known-model nonspiking sufficient-statistic implementation, matches both margins at no greater full execution cost
gates.scope: Synthetic matched-model evidence only; no general lower bound, no imported Hölder-space theorem, no production activation

cost.timing: CPU process_time and wall perf_counter, full history preparation plus prediction plus action selection; batch and scalar workloads reported separately
cost.include: data/teacher generation, train/dev selection, failed development, preprocessing, model serialization, inference and decision; native logging/recovery is a separate integrated track

uncertainty: Paired episode bootstrap (1000 resamples) on seed-averaged metrics, descriptive only; seeded training results also reported individually.
